name: setProsper3P
func:
var uid = msg.topic.split("/");
var data = msg.payload;
var timestamp = Date.now()

// ดึงข้อมูลเวลาที่บันทึกล่าสุดสำหรับ uid ที่ระบุ ++
var lastSavedTimestamp = flow.get('lastSavedTimestamp' + uid[1] + data[31]);
// Check if 2 minutes have passed since the last save
if (!lastSavedTimestamp || (timestamp - lastSavedTimestamp) >= 120000 || (data[1] != 12 || data[1] != 2)) {
    const date = new Date(timestamp + (7 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
    const formattedDate = `${date.getFullYear()}-${(date.getMonth() + 1).toString().padStart(2, '0')}-${date.getDate().toString().padStart(2, '0')} ${date.getHours().toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${date.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${date.getSeconds().toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;

    msg.payload = [formattedDate + "," + //Datetimes
        data[0] + "," +  //HeadCode:
        data[1] + "," + //SendOrder:
        ((data[3] << 8) + data[2]) + "," +    //Voltage:
        ((data[5] << 8) + data[4]) + "," +    //Current:
        ((data[7] << 8) + data[6]) + "," +    //Power:
        ((data[9] << 8) + data[8]) + "," +    //Days:
        data[10] + "," +    //LeakageCurrent: 
        data[11] + "," +    //PowerFactor: 
        data[12] + "," +    //ONOFF: 
        data[13] + "," +    //FaultStuation: 
        data[14] + "," +    //LeakageSetValue:
        data[15] + "," +    //RateOfCurrentSetValue: 
        ((data[17] << 8) + data[16]) + "," +  //UnderVoltSet:
        ((data[19] << 8) + data[18]) + "," +  //OverVoltageSet: 
        data[20] + "," +    //TripSelectBit: 
        data[21] + "," +    //Lern_Flag: 
        data[22] + "," +    //Carrent_Offset: 
        data[23] + "," +    //WaveStyle1: 
        data[24] + "," +    //WaveStyle2: 
        data[25] + "," +    //"LearnWaveCode1": 
        data[26] + "," +    //LearnWaveCode2: 
        data[27] + "," +    //LearnWaveCode3:
        data[28] + "," +    //PhaseBit: 
        data[29] + "," +    //VoltOffsetValue: 
        data[30] + "," +    //XValue: 
        data[31] + "," +    //PhaseID: 
        data[32] + "," +    //Temperature: 
        ((data[38] << 8) + (data[37] << 8) + (data[36] << 8) + (data[35] << 8) + (data[34] << 8) + data[33]) + "," +  //MacAddress: 
        ((data[53] << 8) + (data[52] << 8) + (data[51] << 8) + (data[50] << 8) + (data[49] << 8) + (data[48] << 8) + (data[47] << 8) + (data[46] << 8) + (data[45] << 8) + (data[44] << 8) + (data[43] << 8) + (data[42] << 8) + (data[41] << 8) + (data[40] << 8) + data[39]) + "," +    //Dummy: 
        ((data[55] << 8) + data[54]) + "," +  //Years: 
        data[56] + "," +    //Month: 
        data[57] + "," +    //Day: 
        data[58] + "," +    //Hours: 
        data[59] + "," +    //Minutes: 
        data[60] + "," +    // Seconds: 
        data[61] + "," +    //WeekDay: 
        ((data[63] << 8) + data[62]),  //UploadCount: 
    ]
    var data1 = flow.get('newdata' + uid[1])
    var data2 = msg.payload + "\n" + data1
    flow.set("newdata" + uid[1], data2)
    // บันทึกเวลาที่ใช้ล่าสุด
    flow.set('lastSavedTimestamp' + uid[1], timestamp);

}
msg.payload = data2
msg.uid = uid[1]
// flow.set("newdata", "") //clear
return msg;
